_comment: Swedish night trains in Trafiklab's GTFS Sweden 3, read by scripts/adapters/trafiklab-gtfs.mjs. `route` is the feed's route_short_name, which Samtrafiken sets to the train number; `name` (default: route) is the label the Back-on-Track row carries, which the trainsByNumber enrichment looks a row up by. Only routes of routeTypes are considered — 105 is GTFS's 'Sleeper Rail Service', and SJ also files a seated twin of train 1 under 100 that must not be picked. Sleeper routes the feed carries that are deliberately NOT listed (the adapter logs them every night): SJ 60070/60071/70070/70071, the Ånge/Östersund portions train 70/71 is split into during engineering works; Snälltåget 20/21, a single Malmö–Narvik return on 23/27 November 2026 — one run each way is a charter, not a timetable.
